notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b003:l006: Бута бою measures the ditch by the height or length of a бута; 'a shrub’s height' is provisional.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b003:l008: Буттап дилде сер describes a lavish measured offer of gold and сер; the unit or second valuable is uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b003:l012: Бейдаарат literally means ritually unwashed or unclean; it emphasizes how strictly the horse was concealed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b003:l030: Азуусун чайкап is a horse-age formula involving the canine teeth; 'loosen his fangs' preserves the image but its technical aging sense is uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b003:l031: Ардай is read as ever-ready or spirited in this praise of Buurul; the precise adjective is uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b003:l037: Олоңдотуп describes the manner or length of Buurul’s tether; 'with a long, loose line' is contextual.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b005:l002: Кайгуулун кайтып алууга may mean intercepting, turning back, or taking over Kongurbai’s patrol; the mission is reconnaissance in the following lines.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b005:l026: Колоктогон is an admiring physical epithet for the hero; 'broad' is contextual.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p1417:b005:l036: The printed asterisk marks азан, the Islamic call to prayer.
